facts.text: I am looking for a good resort in Hawaii for a family vacation.
I need a place that can accommodate a large family comfortably.
I just got back from a small family gathering to celebrate my cousin's new baby boy.
I am considering a family vacation for around 15 to 20 people.
My group includes kids and adults.
The kids' ages range from 5 to 15.
I am open to all-inclusive options, but they are not necessary.
I am interested in visiting Oahu and Maui.
My budget is around $500 to $700 per night.
I like the sound of Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa.
I am interested in Aulani's kids' clubs and water park.
I am not sure if Aulani can accommodate my entire family in one room.
I want to know if Aulani has options for connecting rooms or villas that can fit 15 to 20 people.
I want to know if Aulani offers discounts for large family groups or long stays.
I plan to contact Aulani's reservation team to discuss our options.
I want to plan fun activities for the family during the trip.
I want activities in Oahu and Maui suitable for kids of different ages.
I want to find good restaurants in Oahu and Maui that can accommodate large family groups.
I want to have a few family dinners together during the trip.
I want to plan a fun outing to a luau.
I want recommendations for popular luaus in Oahu and Maui that can accommodate large family groups.
I would love to experience a traditional Hawaiian luau with my family.
